meta.title: done. — model our home
meta.description: Trace the floorplan you already have into a 3D model of your home, then furnish it, paint it, and walk through it in your browser.

home.description: Bring the floorplan you already have, draw your walls over it to scale, and walk the result. A sofa that fits, paint you can buy, a room that's actually yours.

help.title: Help
help.slideMouse: Scroll wheel pressed + drag, or Space + drag

welcome.label: Welcome to done.
welcome.body: Turn your floor plan into a 3D home you can furnish and walk through. It takes four steps, and we'll show a short tip at each one.
welcome.traceDesc: Upload your plan and draw its walls
welcome.note: Your plan saves in this browser. Sign in to keep it in your account. All tips live under the ? button.

scale.title: How big is your plan?
scale.body: Your plan is a picture, so done. doesn't know its real size yet. Click two points on the plan, then type the real distance between them. Use whichever is easier:
scale.dimBody: Click both ends of a dimension line and type the number written on it. Israeli plans write these in centimetres.
scale.doorBody: No numbers? Click both sides of a door opening and type 90.
scale.noteMouse: For accurate clicks, zoom in first with the scroll wheel. Drag the plan to move it around.
scale.noteTrackpad: For accurate clicks, zoom in first by pinching. Click and drag the plan to move it around.

scale2.title: Now type the distance
scale2.body: In centimetres. If you clicked a dimension line, type the number written on it. If you clicked a door, type 90. Then press {apply}.

walls.title: Trace your home in this order
walls.wallsBody: Click at each corner, along the middle of the dark wall lines. Go all the way round and click your first corner again: the room turns green. Use <chip>{exterior}</chip> for outside walls, <chip>{interior}</chip> for walls between rooms.
walls.railBody: Switch to <chip>{rail}</chip> and trace the balcony's outer edge. A rail is the low see-through railing, not a wall.
walls.openBody: Where two spaces flow into each other with no wall, like a living room into a kitchen, pick <chip>{open}</chip> and draw across the gap.
walls.note: To stop a line, press Esc or {finish}. Doors and windows come next, in step 4.

rail.title: Balconies and terraces
rail.step2: Click along the balcony's outer edge, not over the house wall.
rail.step3: Finish on the house wall. The balcony turns green like a room, gets a floor, and shows a glass railing in 3D.

openings.title: Go over each door and window
openings.body: Pick <chip>{door}</chip> or <chip>{window}</chip>, then click one side of the opening on the plan and then the other.
openings.note: On a plan, a door is a gap in the wall with a curved swing line. A window is a thin double line inside the wall. Sliding doors to the balcony count as {door}.

build.title: Check the green before you build
build.body: Every green area becomes a room with a floor you can decorate. An area that isn't green isn't closed yet: go back to Walls and click its first corner again.
build.note: After building you can still change everything in 3D.

editor.timeOfDayNoEffect: Time of day has no effect in the Studio preset
editor.viewportKeys: Arrow keys or W A S D move the camera, comma and period orbit, T toggles top view, F frames the selection, Home frames the whole house. With an item selected: R rotates, Delete removes, Escape deselects. Ctrl+Z undoes, Ctrl+Y redoes.

tools.railTip: Balcony/terrace railing — low, see-through barrier that bounds an outdoor space
tools.openTip: Open boundary — closes the room without building anything. Use where a space simply gives onto the next (living room to corridor); no wall, no door needed.

finish.label: Finish
finish.wallsArmedTip: End this run of walls — the next click starts a fresh one (Esc does the same)
finish.wallsIdleTip: Ends a run of walls once you've started one
finish.stairArmedTip: Commit this staircase (Esc does the same)
finish.stairIdleTip: Commits a staircase once you've started one

openings.hint: Draw doors and windows by hand: pick a tool below, then click two points along a wall.

stairs.hint1: Click the foot of the run, then its head, then either long edge to set the width. Keep clicking to add flights — the flat gap you leave between two of them becomes the landing. Esc finishes the staircase.
stairs.riseHint: Rise is the TOTAL climb of the whole staircase — a full storey by default, less for a terrace, a stoop or a split level.
stairs.autoTip: Derive the step count from the rise again
stairs.nudgeHint: Nudge Steps until the ladder on the canvas lines up with the treads drawn on the plan — then the model matches the drawing.

build.closeLoopHint: Close at least one room loop — walls must connect back on themselves to make a floor.
build.squareUpHint: Straightens walls traced a degree or two out — the ortho lock lets them through whenever you click onto an existing corner or the plan underneath. Genuinely angled walls are left as drawn.
build.generateHint: Builds the model and takes you to Build mode. Everything stays editable in 3D.

legalCredits.intro: done. furnishes rooms with 3D models from several outside sources. Some are released under a Creative Commons Attribution license, which requires visible credit to the model's author — that credit is listed below, exactly as each source requires it. Models released under CC0 (public domain) don't legally require attribution; they're listed here anyway, briefly, as a courtesy to the people who made them.
legalCredits.sketchfabIntro: {count, plural, one {# model} other {# models}} licensed CC Attribution 4.0.
legalCredits.polypizzaIntro: {count, plural, one {# model} other {# models}} licensed CC Attribution 3.0.
legalCredits.cc0Body: The rest of the furniture catalog is CC0 — public domain, no attribution required. It's drawn from BlenderKit and Poly Haven, both listed here as a courtesy to their contributors. Floor materials are CC0 too, from ambientCG.
legalCredits.photoBody: Real photographs and paintings used for screens, prints, and wall art are public domain, courtesy of NASA and the Art Institute of Chicago.

accountPage.title: Your data
accountPage.notConfigured: Accounts are not configured on this deployment. Nothing is stored on a server.
accountPage.signedOut: Sign in from the editor to see and manage the data on your account.
accountPage.localPlansNote: Plans you never signed in with stay in this browser only and are not counted here — deleting your account removes those too.
accountPage.exportNote: One JSON file with your profile, every plan's geometry, and the plan images and thumbnails themselves, inlined. Large accounts take a moment — the images are included in full, not linked.
accountPage.deleted: Your account and its data have been deleted. Signing you out…
accountPage.deletionUnavailable: Deletion is not available on this deployment: the server has no SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, so the sign-in itself could not be removed. Rather than half-delete your account, the button is withheld.
accountPage.deleteIntro: This cannot be undone. There is no backup to restore from. It removes:
accountPage.removesPlans: every plan on your account, and its geometry
accountPage.removesImages: every plan image and thumbnail you have uploaded
accountPage.removesRooms: every shared live room you own — share links you have sent will stop working for the people you sent them to
accountPage.removesSignIn: your Google sign-in for this app
accountPage.removesLocal: every plan stored in this browser, including ones you made before signing in and never synced
accountPage.cannotRemove: What it cannot remove: if you shared a plan, that person's own copy lives in their browser and, if they are signed in, on their own account. It is their data now and we have no way to reach it.
accountPage.confirmFieldLabel: Type your email address to confirm account deletion
accountPage.deleteButton: Permanently delete my account and data
accountPage.deleteFailed: Deletion failed. Nothing was removed from this browser.
accountPage.retryNote: Nothing was removed from this browser. Retrying is safe — every step that already succeeded is skipped.
accountPage.reauthRequired: For your security, deleting an account needs a fresh sign-in. Sign in again, then come back here and delete.

report.metaDescription: Report a plan, a shared link, a live room, or an uploaded image on done.
report.title: Report content
report.intro: Use this form to report a plan, a shared link, a live collaboration room, or an uploaded image on done. that infringes your rights, exposes someone's private information, or otherwise violates our policies. You do not need an account to file a report, and we do not require your contact information.

targetKind.share_link: A share link someone sent me

report.targetIdHint: Paste the share link (e.g. .../v/floorplan-...), the plan's name, or however you identify it. If you're not sure, just describe where you saw it — this is free text.
report.detailHint: What's wrong, and anything else that helps us find and review it.
report.contactHint: Only if you'd like to hear back. Leave blank to report anonymously.
report.doneBody: Thank you. Your report has been received and will be reviewed. Because a report can involve another person's account, we generally do not share details about what action was taken — if you gave an email address and it would help to hear back, we may follow up there.
report.errorGeneric: Could not submit the report. Please try again.
report.errorRateLimited: You're submitting reports faster than we can accept them. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
report.errorUnavailable: Reporting is temporarily unavailable on this deployment. Please try again shortly.
report.privacyNoteAfter: for how any personal information you include in a report is handled.
